orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
CRLR No. 7 of 2020 
With 
CRMA No. 58/2020 (Stay application) 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J. 
Mr. R.P. Nautiyal, Senior Advocate 
for the revisionist. 
Mr. P.S. Bohra, A.G.A. along with 
Mr. Siddhartha Bisht, Brief Holder for the 
State of Uttarakhand. 
Admit. 
Issue notice to respondent no. 2, for 
which steps to be taken within a week. 
No notice is required to be sent to 
respondent no. 3 as he is a minor represented 
by respondent no. 2. 
Summon the lower court record. 
Subject to the condition that the 
revisionist pays a sum of Rs. 10,000/- as 
maintenance towards the respondent no. 2 
and continues to remit a maintenance of Rs. 
5,000/- to respondent no. 3, the effect and 
operation of the impugned judgment shall 
remain stayed till the next date of listing. 
Stay application stands disposed of. 
 
 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 
 08.01.2020 
Pooja

assisted by Mr. Tejas Agarwal, Advocate 
for the revisionist.
Mrs. Pushpa Bhatt, Deputy A.G. 
along with Mr. Ranjan Ghildiyal, Brief 
Holder for the State of Uttarakhand. 
Ms. Charanjeet Kaur, Advocate for 
respondent no. 2 and 3.
On 10.09.2020, parties were 
directed to appear before this Court 
through Video Conferencing. 
Today, revisionist (husband) and 
respondent no. 2(wife) are present before 
this Court through Video Conferencing. 
With the consent of the parties, the 
matter is referred for mediation. 
Let the matter be referred to the 
Mediation Center, Udham Singh Nagar. 
The district Judge, Udham Singh Nagar 
may do the needful in this regard. 
Let the parties appear before the In￾charge of Mediation Cell, Udham Singh 
Nagar for the purpose of compromise on 
25.09.2020.
The Mediation Cell, Udham Singh 
Nagar may submit a report.
List this case after report is 
received. 
 (N.S. Dhanik, J.)
